question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, and should that behavior be opt-in or default-on for existing users?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and belongs in the plugin boundary, but it changes official plugin retrieval semantics, persistent indexing, config/defaults, and fallback policy.

options.title: Implement opt-in hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode behind explicit config while preserving vector-only behavior for existing users.

options.title: Make hybrid default-on
options.body: Enable hybrid by default with vector fallback, accepting the upgrade risk from new FTS indexing and changed ranking semantics.

options.title: Keep LanceDB vector-only
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb as a vector backend and point advanced hybrid/rerank behavior to external plugin or ClawHub paths.

recommendation.title: Implement opt-in hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode behind explicit config while preserving vector-only behavior for existing users.
